Package com.example.ecolums

Class BadgeDefinitions

java.lang.Object
com.example.ecolums.BadgeDefinitions
public class BadgeDefinitions extends Object
Hardcoded starter badge definitions. These are seeded into Firestore by the admin via the "Seed Defaults" button. They are BASIC tier badges intended to keep new users engaged.
